contract.colourModel: OKLab key curves through the five anchor shades of each key family, extended 0.6 steps past both ends; t from lightness; deviation relative to the curve's chroma (src/ui/88_harmony_contract.js colour)

notShown.atlas_lamplet: hangs at the hip, below the ink band crop
notShown.bottles: companion-only (Mio); carried at the hip, below the crop — her vial is part of her painted frames
notShown.cane: not carried by any party member
notShown.lamp: companion-only (Ren); held in their painted frames
notShown.patches: companion-only (Ren); part of their painted coat
notShown.pencil: companion-only (Nao); part of their painted frames

companionOnly.high: Ren's high collar (portrait.collar), drawn over their coat: their frames are painted, not a kit option

fallback.note: an unknown style draws as short (src/engine/32h_spritehair.js, src/ui/88_harmony_hair.js hairPart)

hairstyles.wrap: a cloth head wrap in the clothTrim channel (look.wrapCol || cloth[2])

atlas_cos_lamplet.name: Little Lantern
atlas_cos_lamplet.reason: hangs at the hip, below the ink band crop

accessory.ramp: RB.harmonyKit.M(name, colour, opts) with the opts below (as 88_harmony_acc.js draws it)
accessory.resolve: per accessory file: look[field], else the default (cloth.2 = the cloth trim; metal = the gold metal ramp)

clothTrim.ramp: clothMat(cloth[2], { step: 0.09 }); the wrap: clothMat(wrapCol || cloth[2])
clothTrim.resolve: colorsOf(look).cloth[2]; the wrap hairstyle uses look.wrapCol || cloth[2]

fixed.note: never recoloured: eye whites, irises, outlines (#140c18 family), glasses, highlights, metal, leather, glass, and every companion pixel

hair.ramp: RB.harmonyKit.hairMat(hair) — 6 tones round the mid colour
hair.resolve: colorsOf(look).hair (an index into HAIR, or an explicit [dark, mid, light])

keyFamilies.note: contract v3: each recolourable material is painted in its key family — the five anchor shades of KEY_RAMPS (contract.keyRamps) with any number of values between and a little beyond them; the game maps each painted value onto the ramp above (key shade s at the tone pick[s]) and keeps its hue and chroma deviation

playerIris.note: the code busts give every player this iris (RB.harmonyKit.faceColours default); it is not a look field

skin.resolve: RB.sprites.colorsOf(look).skin (an index into SKIN, or an explicit [light, shadow] pair)

resolver.lookWith: copies the base look, drops the accessories in the same place (SAME_PLACE[it.acc] or [it.acc]), appends it.acc last, then Object.assign(out, it.wear)

source.note: git.commit is HEAD when exported; the export is committed with or after it. indexHtml is the build it was read from.
